original.title: Toward a knowledge‐based theory of the firm

core_idea: Knowledge is the most strategically important resource of the firm. Firms exist because they integrate the specialized knowledge of individuals better than markets can. Organizational design is about coordinating knowledge integration.
key_concepts_note: Use the concepts already stored for this theory in the library (theories.concepts).
when_to_use: How do organizations create, share and integrate knowledge?
Why do some firms transfer best practices better than others?
Typical data: case studies, surveys of knowledge sharing, network data.
common_mistakes: Assuming knowledge lives only at firm level.
Ignoring tacit knowledge, which is hard to transfer.
